description: This file defines an interface for an Orleans grain used in testing, and a data class for activity data serialization.

classes.name: IActivityGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain interface with a method to get activity data.

classes.name: ActivityData
classes.description: A serializable class holding activity information with Id, TraceState, and Baggage fields.

methods.name: GetActivityId
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves activity data associated with the grain.
